policy: Review every deterministic maintainer-substantive-v3 match against the full issue-opening report and full acknowledgment comment. accepted and ambiguous remain positive; rejected is relabeled negative. Ambiguous is retained only when the maintainer connects the report to a known fix, workaround, or underlying defect without an explicit reproduction statement.

reviews.reason: Maintainer confirms the tested build postdates the shipped fix.
Maintainer closes as resolved based on non-recurrence, but does not identify a fix.
Maintainer links the pull request that fixes the failing test.
Maintainer states that the login issue was fixed and asks affected users to retry.
Maintainer names the prerelease containing the fix.
Maintainer says the issue remains and commits to a fix after confirming the profile.
Maintainer states that the defect is fixed in Insiders but not the stable release.
Maintainer links the regression-fix pull request.
The comment only asks whether Insiders fixed the report; it does not acknowledge or reproduce it.
Maintainer states the exact report appears fixed in Insiders.
Maintainer identifies the root cause.
Maintainer connects the report to a tracked upstream defect and fix, but leaves notebook-specific impact open.
Maintainer identifies buggy locations, the fix pull request, and the planned release.

Maintainer explicitly cannot reproduce the exact report and refers only to a similar fixed issue.
Maintainer independently reports being unable to install the prerelease, confirming the failure.
Maintainer states that the defect is fixed in Insiders and the next stable release.
